title: LLMs are Superior Feedback Providers: Bootstrapping Reasoning for Lie Detection with Self-Generated Feedback
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical and reasoning capability of LLMs to detect deception (lies) in the context of the game 'Diplomacy'. While deception is a moral concept, the paper treats it as a task of nuanced language understanding and reasoning performance, rather than evaluating or benchmarking religious values, ethical frameworks, or moral philosophy.
